Instrument the Go key-value store service in ./service with OpenTelemetry while preserving the existing runtime and startup command. Add auto-instrumentation only; do not add custom business spans.

judge_inputs: Inspect ./service for resulting files when present.

rubric: Instruments the executable server path under cmd/kvstore-server, not the library package on import.
Preserves the existing kvstore package APIs and avoids moving business logic.
Uses otelhttp.NewHandler for stdlib HTTP routing and keeps span names low-cardinality.
Reads service name and OTLP endpoint from environment or safe defaults.

Bridges the existing standard logger through exactly one official Go logging bridge and one shared-resource batched OTLP LoggerProvider targeting the signal-specific local Observer /v1/logs endpoint by default; preserves the existing console sink, honors OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER=none and other explicit operator ownership, shuts the provider down, avoids duplicate records, and never configures cloud log credentials or forwarding.
